provenance.citation: Elastic corneoscleral FEM (no remodeling; spec §7). Approximations: the document's geometry is taken as stress-free and the result is the change from the IOP-only state; fixed optic-nerve support; muscle forces from length-proxy activation x capacity, torque-balanced, with the net force taken by an orbital reaction on the posterior hemisphere; dead loads in the reference configuration; lens follows the scleral spur and the retina the posterior pole. Materials, thickness, eyelid, and force data are unverified (see data/materials, data/eyelid, data/eom). Tests the hypothesis that muscle and lid loading shape the cornea; not an established result.

frame: right eye, origin at the globe center (taken as the center of rotation, an approximation), x temporal, y superior, z posterior (toward the retina), mm

provenance.citation: Navarro, Santamaría, Bescós, J Opt Soc Am A 2(8):1273-1281, 1985, Table 1 (d-line indices); mirrors data/schematic-eyes/navarro-1985.json; paraxial power 60.42 D, see spec §5.6
